name: Andaman Islands
blurb: Clear water, coral reefs and quiet white-sand beaches on Havelock and Neil.

reach.airport: Veer Savarkar Intl Airport (IXZ), Port Blair (connected from MAA, BLR, CCU, DEL)
reach.railway: No rail connectivity; reachable only via flights or deep-sea passenger ships
reach.local: High-speed catamarans (Makruzz, Nautika), govt ferries, prepaid cabs, auto-rickshaws

tips: Ferries: Book inter-island catamaran tickets (Port Blair–Havelock–Neil) weeks in advance.
Permits: Indian nationals need no permits; RAP is lifted for foreigners on 30 inhabited islands (valid passport/visa required).
Monsoon: Intense June to September with high sea swells and suspended boat trips.
Cellular Jail: Closed Mondays and national holidays; book sound & light tickets online.

days.title: Port Blair & Freedom Heritage
days.morning: Arrive at Port Blair (IXZ); transfer to your hotel and unwind with fresh tender coconut water.
days.afternoon: Tour the national memorial at Cellular Jail and explore the Kalapani freedom struggle galleries.
days.evening: Watch the historic Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show, followed by dinner at Aberdeen Bazaar.

days.title: Havelock (Swaraj Dweep)
days.morning: Board the 90-minute high-speed catamaran from Phoenix Bay Jetty to Havelock harbour.
days.afternoon: Check in at your beachfront resort and head to Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7), Asia’s top white-sand stretch.
days.evening: Witness an unobstructed sunset over the turquoise Andaman Sea; dine at a relaxed garden cafe.

days.title: Elephant Beach Reef & Water Sports
days.morning: Take a 20-minute speed boat to Elephant Beach for guided sea-walking or reef snorkelling.
days.afternoon: Observe vibrant live corals and colourful reef fish; rest in shaded hammocks along the shore.
days.evening: Return to Havelock harbour and stroll through the local island market of Govind Nagar.

days.title: Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
days.morning: Ferry across to peaceful Neil Island; swim in the calm turquoise waters of Bharatpur Beach.
days.afternoon: Marvel at the geological wonder of the Natural Coral Bridge (Howrah Bridge) at low tide.
days.evening: Catch the crimson sunset at Laxmanpur Beach 1 before enjoying fresh grilled reef fish.

days.title: Chidiya Tapu & Coastal Departure
days.morning: Ferry back to Port Blair; visit the Samudrika Naval Marine Museum and Anthropological Museum.
days.afternoon: Drive along mangrove-lined coastal roads to the tranquil rainforest trails of Chidiya Tapu.
days.evening: Shop for handcrafted mother-of-pearl crafts at Sagarika Govt Emporium before your departure flight.

name: Goa
blurb: Fort walls, Portuguese lanes and a beach for every mood.

reach.airport: Dabolim Airport (GOI) or Manohar Intl Airport Mopa (GOX)
reach.local: Pilot motorbike taxis, self-drive scooters/cars, prepaid airport cabs, Goa Kadamba buses

tips: Churches: Strict modest dress code at Basilica of Bom Jesus & Se Cathedral (no sleeveless tops or short skirts/shorts).
Monsoon: Rough seas June to September; water sports suspended, swimming strictly red-flagged.
Scooters: Carry a valid driving license; helmet is legally mandatory for both rider and pillion.
Dudhsagar: Accessible Oct to May via forest department 4x4 jeeps from Kulem.

days.title: North Goa Forts & Candolim
days.morning: Land at Goa airport; drive to your North Goa hotel and sip refreshing chilled kokum juice.
days.afternoon: Explore Fort Aguada’s 17th-century Portuguese ramparts and the historic four-storey lighthouse.
days.evening: Watch the sunset over Candolim beach with fresh Goan poi bread and live acoustic music.

days.title: Old Goa & Fontainhas Heritage
days.morning: Marvel at the Baroque architecture and sacred relics of the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral.
days.afternoon: Stroll through Fontainhas in Panaji, photographing pastel Portuguese villas, azulejo tiles, and art cafes.
days.evening: Take a sunset cruise along the Mandovi River with traditional Goan folk music and dance.

days.title: South Goa & Serene Palolem
days.morning: Drive south to scenic Palolem Beach, nestled between palm-topped headlands in Canacona.
days.afternoon: Take a small boat to Butterfly Beach and Monkey Island for dolphin watching and calm swimming.
days.evening: Savour authentic Goan fish curry, prawn balchao, and bebinca at a seaside candlelit table.

days.title: Ponda Spice Plantations & Divar
days.morning: Visit a traditional spice plantation in Ponda; tour vanilla, nutmeg, and cinnamon plantations.
days.afternoon: Savor an authentic Goan Saraswat buffet lunch served on fresh plantain leaves.
days.evening: Take the local river ferry to peaceful Divar Island for an atmospheric countryside sunset walk.

days.title: Chapora Fort & Anjuna Crafts
days.morning: Hike up to the red laterite ruins of Chapora Fort for panoramic views of Vagator coastline.
days.afternoon: Browse handicrafts, cotton resort-wear, and spices at the bohemian beachside markets.
days.evening: Relax at a cliffside cafe in Vagator before your transfer to the airport or railway station.

name: Gokarna
blurb: A temple town with a string of secluded beaches, reached on foot.

reach.airport: Goa Dabolim (GOI, ~140 km) or Hubballi (HBX, ~150 km)
reach.railway: Gokarna Road (GOK, ~9 km) or Kumta (KT, ~31 km)
reach.local: Auto-rickshaws, cliff hiking trails between beaches, local motorized boat transfers

tips: Temple Dress Code: Mahabaleshwar Temple enforces traditional attire (dhoti for men; shirts removed in inner sanctum).
Beach Trekking: Half Moon and Paradise beaches have no road access; carry water and headlamps for walking.
Monsoon: Sea currents are very strong June to August; rocky headlands become dangerously slick.
Cash: ATMs in town frequently run out; keep cash for beach cafes and boatmen.

days.title: Arrival & Om Beach Sunset
days.morning: Arrive via Gokarna Road or Kumta; check into a cliffside cottage overlooking Om Beach.
days.afternoon: Relax on Om Beach, admiring the unique rock contours naturally shaped like the sacred symbol.
days.evening: Watch the crimson sun dip into the Arabian Sea while dining on wood-fired pizza and fresh juices.

days.title: The 5-Beaches Coastal Trek
days.morning: Trek the scenic coastal path from Om Beach over headlands to secluded Half Moon Beach.
days.afternoon: Reach pristine Paradise Beach, accessible only on foot or boat; swim in clear turquoise waters.
days.evening: Take a boat back to Kudle Beach; enjoy an open-air yoga session and live music at a beach cafe.

days.title: Mahabaleshwar Temple & Town
days.morning: Early morning darshan at the 4th-century Mahabaleshwar Temple, housing the venerated Atmalinga.
days.afternoon: Visit the holy Kotitirtha water tank and shop for brass lamps, incense, and herbal oils.
days.evening: Walk the wide expanse of Gokarna Main Beach; watch fishermen pull in their evening nets.

days.title: Yana Karst Rocks & Mirjan Fort
days.morning: Drive 45 km into the lush Western Ghats forest to the towering monolithic limestone Yana Rocks.
days.afternoon: Hike through rainforest shade beneath Bhairaveshwara Shikhara; stop by historic Mirjan Fort.
days.evening: Explore Mirjan Fort’s moss-draped laterite walls and watch sunset over the Aghanashini river.

days.title: Kudle Leisure & Departure
days.morning: Wake up to a quiet beach walk along Kudle; enjoy breakfast with tropical fresh fruit bowls.
days.afternoon: Pick up handwoven cotton trousers, souvenirs, and spice packets from local stalls.
days.evening: Final coastal breeze walk before catching your train at Gokarna Road or Kumta station.

name: Munnar
blurb: Tea terraces rolling over cool mountain slopes above the clouds.

reach.airport: Cochin International Airport (COK, ~110 km / 3.5 hrs via NH85)
reach.railway: Aluva (AWY, ~110 km) or Ernakulam Junction (ERS, ~130 km)
reach.local: Hired tourist taxis, auto-rickshaws, 4WD jeeps for high-altitude spots like Kolukkumalai

tips: Eravikulam Park: Closed annually for ~60 days (Feb to March/early April) for Nilgiri Tahr calving; book online.
Tea Museum: KDHP Tea Museum at Nullatanni is closed on Mondays.
Winter Chill: Temperatures dip below 10°C (near 0°C at Kolukkumalai) in Dec–Jan; pack warm layers.
Ghat Driving: Mountain roads are subject to thick fog; avoid late-night driving.

days.title: Tea Country & KDHP Museum
days.morning: Scenic drive up the misty Western Ghats via Neriamangalam; check into your tea-estate stay.
days.afternoon: Tour the KDHP Tea Museum at Nullatanni; observe orthodox tea processing from leaf to packet.
days.evening: Walk through emerald tea garden slopes; warm up with freshly brewed estate tea by the fireplace.

days.title: Eravikulam & Mattupetty Dam
days.morning: Board the forest eco-bus at Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai) to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr.
days.afternoon: Stop at Mattupetty Dam for speed-boating, followed by the fun acoustic reverberations of Echo Point.
days.evening: Enjoy a serene pedal-boat ride at Kundala Lake amidst Kashmiri shikaras and tea-covered shores.

days.title: Top Station & High Vistas
days.morning: Ascend to Top Station viewpoint (1,880 m) on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border before morning mist rolls in.
days.afternoon: Pause at panoramic viewpoints along the route; sample roasted spiced corn and homemade chocolates.
days.evening: Browse Munnar town market for eucalyptus oil, organic green cardamom, clove, and fresh pepper.

days.title: Kolukkumalai 4x4 Off-Road Sunrise
days.morning: Take a rugged early 4WD jeep ride up to Kolukkumalai (7,130 ft), the highest tea plantation in the world.
days.afternoon: Tour the heritage 1930s wood-and-roller tea factory; sample delicate floral single-origin black teas.
days.evening: Descend to Munnar; enjoy a traditional Kerala Sadhya dinner served on a fresh banana leaf.

days.title: Marayoor Sandalwood & Waterfalls
days.morning: Drive through the fragrant natural sandalwood forest of Marayoor; see Neolithic dolmens (Muniyaras).
days.afternoon: Stop by the roaring cascade of Cheeyappara Waterfalls tumbling down in seven distinct tiers.
days.evening: Scenic drive down through the rubber plantations towards Cochin Airport for your evening flight.

name: Coorg
blurb: Coffee estates, waterfalls and misty ridges, an easy drive from Bengaluru.

reach.airport: Kannur Intl (CNN, ~90 km), Mangaluru (IXE, ~140 km), or Bengaluru (BLR, ~285 km)
reach.railway: Mysuru Junction (MYS, ~120 km) or Hassan (HAS, ~115 km)
reach.local: Hired private cars, local KSRTC buses, 4x4 jeeps for Mandalpatti peak

tips: Dubare Camp: Elephant bathing and feeding runs strictly 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM; river crossing subject to water level.
Namdroling Monastery: Maintain silence in prayer halls during monk chanting sessions; remove footwear.
Rainforest Leeches: Common around Abbey and Iruppu falls during and right after monsoon; wear proper footwear.
Coffee Harvest: Coffee blossom season is March–April; berry harvest takes place December to February.

days.title: Abbey Falls & Coffee Walk
days.morning: Drive into Kodagu through coffee-scented valleys; check into a heritage planter’s estate homestay.
days.afternoon: Walk down to Abbey Falls, roaring through dense coffee shrubs and pepper vines.
days.evening: Take a guided estate plantation walk learning about Arabica and Robusta beans, vanilla, and spices.

days.title: Dubare Elephants & Bylakuppe
days.morning: Cross the Cauvery River to Dubare Elephant Camp for the morning bathing and feeding interaction (9–11 AM).
days.afternoon: Head to Bylakuppe, the largest Tibetan settlement in South India, and visit the serene Namdroling Monastery.
days.evening: Spin Buddhist prayer wheels, listen to monks chanting, and taste authentic Tibetan steamed momos.

days.title: Talakaveri & Raja’s Seat
days.morning: Drive to Talakaveri on Brahmagiri Hills, sacred origin of River Cauvery; climb Brahmagiri peak steps.
days.afternoon: Tour historic Madikeri Fort, the palace museum, and the Gothic-style St. Mark’s Church.
days.evening: Gather at Raja’s Seat garden to watch the sun drop behind mist-draped rolling valleys.

days.title: Mandalpatti 4x4 Viewpoint
days.morning: Board an open 4WD jeep for a rugged climb through misty grassland trails to Mandalpatti peak.
days.afternoon: Enjoy breathtaking 360-degree vistas across Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary.
days.evening: Sample authentic Kodava cuisine: spicy Pandi curry, Kadambuttu (rice dumplings), and bamboo shoot curry.

days.title: Iruppu Falls & Estate Shopping
days.morning: Journey to sacred Iruppu Falls nestled in the Brahmagiri forest; dip your feet in cool mountain waters.
days.afternoon: Explore the fringe forest roads near Nagarhole, watching for chital deer and peacocks.
days.evening: Pick up Coorg wild honey, homemade artisanal chocolates, and freshly roasted estate coffee before departure.

name: Hampi
blurb: Dramatic boulder hills and the majestic ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire.

reach.airport: Jindal Vidyanagar Airport (VDY, ~35 km) or Hubballi (HBX, ~140 km)
reach.railway: Hosapete Junction (HPT, ~13 km from Hampi Bazaar)
reach.local: Rented bicycles, scooters/mopeds, auto-rickshaws, licensed coracle ferries

tips: Scorching Summer: March to June exceeds 38°C with bare rock radiation; winter (Nov–Jan) is ideal.
ASI Protection: Tapping or touching musical pillars at Vittala Temple is strictly prohibited.
Footwear: Extensive walking on uneven rock terrain; wear sturdy walking shoes with good grip.
Coracles: Wearing police-approved life jackets is strictly mandatory on Tungabhadra river crossings.

days.title: Virupaksha & Sacred Centre
days.morning: Arrive via Hosapete Junction; check into a boulder-view retreat near Hampi Bazaar.
days.afternoon: Visit the 7th-century active Virupaksha Temple, Kadalekalu Ganesha, and Sasivekalu Ganesha.
days.evening: Walk down the colonnaded Hampi Bazaar and watch sunset from Hemakuta Hill’s cluster of ancient shrines.

days.title: Vittala Temple & Royal Enclosure
days.morning: Marvel at the iconic Stone Chariot and the intricate pillared hall at the Vittala Temple Complex.
days.afternoon: Take an eco-buggy back, then explore the Queen’s Bath, Lotus Mahal, and the vaulted Elephant Stables.
days.evening: Take a traditional round coracle boat ride on the Tungabhadra River, navigating granite boulder rapids.

days.title: Matanga Hill Dawn & Achyutaraya
days.morning: Dawn hike up Matanga Hill for a panoramic 360-degree sunrise view over the vast ruined imperial capital.
days.afternoon: Descend through the historic Courtesan’s Street to the evocative, peaceful Achyutaraya Temple ruins.
days.evening: Relax at a riverside garden cafe across the river; enjoy fresh South Indian and Mediterranean thalis.

days.title: Anegundi & Sanapur Lake
days.morning: Cross over to ancient Anegundi, legendary monkey kingdom of Kishkindha.
days.afternoon: Climb the white steps of Anjaneya Hill (Hanuman’s birthplace); enjoy the tranquil waters of Sanapur Lake.
days.evening: Try introductory bouldering with local climbing guides or unwind with a sunset coracle glide.

days.title: Pattabhirama & Daroji Bear Sanctuary
days.morning: Visit the grand Pattabhirama Temple and the ASI Archaeological Museum at Kamalapura.
days.afternoon: Drive to Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary to observe sloth bears foraging on rocky hills from the watchtower.
days.evening: Final heritage stroll along the Tungabhadra riverbank before catching your night train from Hosapete.

name: Alleppey (Alappuzha)
blurb: Venice of the East with endless palm-lined canals, houseboats and below-sea-level paddy fields.

reach.railway: Alappuzha Railway Station (ALLP, ~3 km from town boat jetty)
reach.local: Auto-rickshaws, KSWTD public scenic water ferries (₹10–40), private motor shikaras, houseboats

tips: Houseboat Law: Kerala tourism rules require all houseboats to anchor by 5:30 PM for fishermen nets; cruising resumes 8:00 AM.
Air Conditioning: In standard deluxe houseboats, AC runs 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM in bedrooms; book luxury for 24-hr salon AC.
Nehru Trophy: The famous snake boat race is held on Punnamada Lake on the 2nd Saturday of August.
Certification: Choose DTPC-accredited houseboats (Gold or Green leaf emblems) for verified waste safety.

days.title: Boarding Kettuvallam & Lake Vembanad
days.morning: Arrive in Alleppey; transfer to Punnamada Jetty to board your private thatched houseboat (Kettuvallam).
days.afternoon: Cruise through palm-fringed backwaters while chefs prepare authentic Karimeen Pollichathu (pearl spot fish).
days.evening: Boat anchors at 5:30 PM by peaceful village banks; take an evening stroll along lush paddy dykes.

days.title: Kuttanad Canals & Country Canoe
days.morning: Watch village life awaken over breakfast as your boat glides past duck farms and lotus clusters.
days.afternoon: Switch to a narrow wooden country canoe to explore interior village canals inaccessible to big boats.
days.evening: Visit the historic 11th-century Karumadi Kuttan Buddha statue; catch sunset over Marari Beach.

days.title: Alleppey Lighthouse & Coir Heritage
days.morning: Tour the International Coir Museum to discover how coconut husk is woven into golden carpets and ropes.
days.afternoon: Climb the 1862 Alleppey Lighthouse for panoramic views over the Arabian coastline and historic pier.
days.evening: Walk the historic Alleppey Beach pier at sunset, savouring hot banana fritters and spiced tea.

days.title: Pathiramanal Island & Village Cycling
days.morning: Rent a bicycle to ride along quiet coastal village paths between backwaters and the sea.
days.afternoon: Take a boat to emerald Pathiramanal Island (Sands of Midnight) to observe migratory water birds.
days.evening: Dine on Malabar parotta, appams, and creamy vegetable stew under lantern-lit palm trees.

days.title: Champakulam Church & Departure
days.morning: Visit Champakulam Kalloorkadu St. Mary’s Forane Church, established in 427 CE on the riverbank.
days.afternoon: See the prized 130-foot racing snake boats (Chundan Vallam) housed in traditional village sheds.
days.evening: Scenic drive along NH66 back towards Cochin International Airport for your connecting flight.

name: Kochi (Fort Kochi)
blurb: Chinese fishing nets, spice warehouses, colonial churches and lively contemporary art.

reach.airport: Cochin International Airport (COK, ~40 km / 1 hr 15 min)
reach.local: Kochi Water Metro (AC electric catamarans), Ro-Ro vehicle ferries, rental cycles, auto-rickshaws

tips: Closures: Mattancherry Dutch Palace is closed Fridays. Paradesi Synagogue is closed Fridays, Saturdays and Jewish holidays.
Synagogue Attire: Modest dress required (shoulders and knees covered); shoes must be deposited at entrance.
Kochi Biennale: The prestigious art biennale runs every two years (Dec to April) across heritage warehouses.
Kathakali Makeup: Arrive at Kerala Kathakali Centre by 5:00 PM to witness the artists applying natural mineral face makeup.

days.title: Chinese Nets & Colonial Ramparts
days.morning: Arrive at Cochin Airport; take the electric Kochi Water Metro or drive to your heritage Fort Kochi stay.
days.afternoon: Walk along Vasco da Gama Square to watch fishermen operate the colossal cantilevered Chinese Fishing Nets.
days.evening: Visit St. Francis Church, India’s oldest European church where Vasco da Gama was first buried in 1524.

days.title: Jew Town, Synagogue & Dutch Palace
days.morning: Explore the antique spice godowns of Jew Town and visit the 1568 Paradesi Synagogue with Belgian glass chandeliers.
days.afternoon: Tour Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace) to admire the vibrant 16th-century Ramayana mythological murals.
days.evening: Attend an evening classical Kathakali dance-drama at Kerala Kathakali Centre; arrive early for makeup.

days.title: Spice Markets & Marine Drive
days.morning: Walk through the aromatic ginger and pepper trading warehouses of Mattancherry bazaar.
days.afternoon: Take a harbor ferry across to Ernakulam mainland; stroll along the modern waterfront Marine Drive promenade.
days.evening: Enjoy a rooftop seafood dinner overlooking the illuminated container ships moving along Cochin port.

days.title: Kumbalangi Eco-Village
days.morning: Visit Kumbalangi Model Tourism Village to experience traditional crab farming, coir spinning, and palm weaving.
days.afternoon: Glide silently through tranquil mangrove passages in country canoes; taste fresh coconut water and local snacks.
days.evening: Watch Chinese fishing net silhouettes glow against a fiery orange sunset over the backwater estuary.

days.title: Hill Palace & Kerala Folklore Museum
days.morning: Visit the Kerala Folklore Museum in Thevara, showcasing 4,000 architectural wonders and wooden temple masks.
days.afternoon: Tour the sprawling Hill Palace Museum in Tripunithura, former administrative palace of the Maharaja of Cochin.
days.evening: Pick up freshly fried hot banana chips, whole cardamom, and vanilla beans before heading to Cochin Airport.

name: Thekkady (Periyar)
blurb: Periyar tiger reserve, lake safaris, wild elephant herds and cool cardamom hills.

reach.airport: Madurai Airport (IXM, ~140 km) or Cochin International (COK, ~160 km)
reach.railway: Kottayam Railway Station (KTYM, ~110 km) or Madurai (140 km)
reach.local: Forest eco-tourism shuttle buses, hired jeeps, local auto-rickshaws in Kumily town

tips: Safari Booking: KTDC Lake boat safari tickets must be booked online weeks ahead on periyartigerreserve.org.
Clothing: Wear neutral earthy tones (khakis, greens, browns); loud music, flash photography, and plastic are banned.
Bamboo Rafting: Requires moderate physical fitness and prior forest department booking; includes guided forest trek.
Spice Shopping: Buy certified Grade-A green cardamom and black pepper from Sahyadri or Spices Board outlets in Kumily.

days.title: Arrival in Kumily & Spice Tour
days.morning: Drive up winding cardamom-scented hills into Kumily; check into a jungle retreat near Periyar gate.
days.afternoon: Take a guided walking tour through an organic spice garden, identifying wild cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg.
days.evening: Watch an exhilarating Kalaripayattu ancient martial arts duel at the Kadathanadan Kalari Centre.

days.title: Periyar Lake Boat Safari
days.morning: Board the early morning KTDC boat safari on Periyar Lake; spot wild elephant herds and sambar deer on the banks.
days.afternoon: Join an interpretive Nature Walk along the perimeter of the evergreen jungle with a trained tribal tracker.
days.evening: Enjoy a hearty Kerala meal featuring aromatic spices and freshly harvested garden vegetables.

days.title: Full-Day Bamboo Rafting Expedition
days.morning: Start the Bamboo Rafting eco-trek through moist deciduous forest into the core tiger reserve habitat.
days.afternoon: Paddle quietly on bamboo rafts across the deep forested reaches of the lake with a packed jungle lunch.
days.evening: Return to Kumily town; unwind with a soothing herbal oil Abhyanga Ayurvedic rejuvenation massage.

days.title: Chellarkovil & Pandikuzhi Vistas
days.morning: Drive to Chellarkovil, perched on Kerala’s eastern edge with stunning views looking down on the plains of Tamil Nadu.
days.afternoon: Walk through mountain stream cascades and organic farm valleys at picturesque Pandikuzhi.
days.evening: Shop for fresh cardamom, nutmeg, cinnamon quills, and wild stingless bee honey in Kumily market.

days.title: Gavi Wilderness Safari & Departure
days.morning: Dawn 4WD jeep excursion into the pristine, misty evergreen rainforests of Gavi, home to lion-tailed macaques.
days.afternoon: Canoe quietly across Gavi lake and visit the historic cardamom curing house nestled deep in the forest.
days.evening: Descend through the scenic tea-clad mountain ghats towards Kottayam or Madurai for your onward train or flight.

name: Wayanad
blurb: Mist-clad Western Ghats, prehistoric petroglyphs, earth dams and wildlife sanctuaries.

reach.airport: Calicut Intl Airport (CCJ, ~95 km) or Kannur Intl (CNN, ~90 km)
reach.railway: Kozhikode Railway Station (CLT, ~80 km via scenic Thamarassery Churam ghat)
reach.local: Rented taxis, 4x4 jeeps for rugged plantation and viewpoint tracks, KSRTC mountain buses

tips: Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays. Daily entry is capped at 1,920 visitors; arrive by 8:30 AM to secure entry tickets.
Chembra Peak: Trek to heart-shaped lake requires early morning forest clearance at Meppadi (daily cap of 200 passes).
Night Ghat Ban: Vehicle transit through Bandipur/Muthanga borders is closed 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM to protect wild animals.
Heavy Rains: Southwest monsoon (June–Aug) brings intense downpours; check for temporary trail alerts.

days.title: Thamarassery Churam & Pookode Lake
days.morning: Ascend the dramatic 9 hairpin bends of Thamarassery Ghat; check into a misty treehouse resort in Vythiri.
days.afternoon: Visit freshwater Pookode Lake ringed by evergreen forests; pedal boat amongst blue water lilies.
days.evening: Drive up to Lakkidi View Point to watch evening clouds roll over the deep Thamarassery mountain valley.

days.title: Edakkal Caves & Heritage Museum
days.morning: Climb the stone path to Edakkal Caves to examine prehistoric petroglyphs carved into granite dating to 6000 BCE.
days.afternoon: Tour the Wayanad Heritage Museum at Ambalavayal, housing ancient tribal terracotta, hero stones, and weaponry.
days.evening: Savor bamboo-steamed puttu with spicy Kadala curry and warm spiced ginger tea at a mountain cafe.

days.title: Banasura Sagar Dam & Karlad Lake
days.morning: Visit Banasura Sagar Dam, India’s largest earthen dam; take an exhilarating speedboat ride across the reservoir.
days.afternoon: Zipline across Karlad Lake and try bamboo kayaking along the tranquil water’s edge.
days.evening: Walk through the tea gardens of Pozhuthana and watch sunset from the Kurumbalakotta viewpoint.

days.title: Chembra Peak Heart Lake Trek
days.morning: Obtain early forest permits at Meppadi for the trek through tea estates up to Chembra’s heart-shaped lake.
days.afternoon: Relax beside the mist-enshrouded lake Hridaya Saras, enjoying panoramic views across Nilgiri mountains.
days.evening: Return for an authentic campfire dinner with grilled river fish and steamed tapioca.

days.title: Muthanga Sanctuary & Kuruva Island
days.morning: Dawn jeep safari through Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary at Muthanga; look for spotted deer, gaurs, and wild elephants.
days.afternoon: Walk on bamboo bridges through the river delta islands of Kuruva Dweep on the Kabini River.
days.evening: Drive down the Western Ghats towards Kozhikode (Calicut) Railway Station or Airport for departure.

name: Varkala
blurb: Dramatic red laterite cliffs towering over the Arabian Sea, holy mineral springs and clifftop cafes.

reach.airport: Thiruvananthapuram Intl Airport (TRV, ~42 km / 1 hr 15 min)
reach.railway: Varkala Sivagiri Railway Station (VAK, ~3 km from North Cliff)
reach.local: Auto-rickshaws, rental scooters, walking along the pedestrian-friendly cliff promenade

tips: Cliff Edge Safety: The red laterite cliff edge is fragile and actively eroding; strictly follow barricaded pathways.
Rip Currents: Papanasam Beach has powerful undertows; swim only where lifeguard flags permit.
Temple Attire: Janardhana Swamy Temple requires traditional clothing (dhoti for men; bare torso inside sanctum).
Sunset Seating: North Cliff cafes fill up fast for sunset; grab an oceanfront table by 5:15 PM.

days.title: North Cliff & Papanasam Sunset
days.morning: Arrive via Varkala Sivagiri station or Trivandrum airport; check into a clifftop boutique stay.
days.afternoon: Stroll along the paved North Cliff promenade, perched high above the beach with vibrant cafes and craft stalls.
days.evening: Walk down to Papanasam Beach, famed for natural mineral springs believed to cleanse sins; dine at a clifftop cafe.

days.title: Janardhana Swamy & Black Sand
days.morning: Visit the 2,000-year-old Janardhana Swamy Temple, a historic Vishnu shrine with an ancient Dutch brass bell.
days.afternoon: Walk along the quiet shoreline north to Odayam and Black Sand Beach, away from the bustling main cliff.
days.evening: Join an outdoor sunset yoga session overlooking the Arabian Sea, followed by fresh fruit smoothie bowls.

days.title: Kappil Beach & Backwater Estuary
days.morning: Rent a scooter or take an auto 7 km north to Kappil Beach, where the backwaters meet the sea across a narrow road.
days.afternoon: Take a gentle motorboat or canoe ride on the calm waters of Edava-Nadayara Lake.
days.evening: Hike up to the cliff of Kodi Hills for a spectacular aerial perspective of the sea-backwater confluence.

days.title: Anjengo Fort & Golden Island
days.morning: Visit the historic 17th-century East India Company outpost at Anjengo (Anchuthengu) Fort and Lighthouse.
days.afternoon: Board a country boat to Ponnumthuruthu (Golden Island), home to an ancient Shiva-Parvati shrine amidst mangroves.
days.evening: Feast on wood-fired oven pizza, tandoori tiger prawns, and iced coconut latte at a cliffside shack.

days.title: Sivagiri Mutt & Wellness Departure
days.morning: Visit Sivagiri Mutt, the tranquil final resting place and headquarters of Kerala social reformer Sree Narayana Guru.
days.afternoon: Enjoy a rejuvenating Kerala Ayurvedic herbal steam bath and Shirodhara oil treatment.
days.evening: Final leisurely cliff stroll to buy handmade Tibetan jewelry before your transfer to Trivandrum Airport.

name: Kovalam
blurb: Iconic striped lighthouse, three sheltered crescent beaches, and world-renowned Ayurvedic healing.

reach.local: Prepaid taxis, auto-rickshaws, city buses to East Fort (Padmanabhaswamy Temple)

tips: Lighthouse Timings: Vizhinjam Lighthouse is open to visitors 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM daily (closed on Mondays); elevator available.
Beach Zones: Lighthouse Beach is lively with cafes; Hawah Beach has morning fishermen; Samudra Beach is quiet and upscale.
Ayurveda: Choose centers accredited with Green Leaf or Olive Leaf certification by Kerala Tourism.
Padmanabhaswamy: Strictly enforces traditional dress codes (dhoti for men, sarees for women; phones strictly banned).

days.title: Lighthouse Beach & Tower View
days.morning: Short 25-minute drive from Trivandrum Airport; check in at your coastal resort facing the crescent bay.
days.afternoon: Relax on the golden sands of Lighthouse Beach; climb the 142 steps (or elevator) of Vizhinjam Lighthouse.
days.evening: Dine at beachside promenade restaurants serving freshly caught red snapper and Kerala parottas.

days.title: Hawah Beach & Ayurvedic Care
days.morning: Watch traditional fishermen haul in shore seine nets at Hawah Beach (Eve’s Beach) in early morning sunlight.
days.afternoon: Indulge in an authentic 90-minute Ayurvedic massage and herbal body polish at a Green Leaf certified center.
days.evening: Walk the quiet palm groves of Samudra Beach; view the heritage facade of Halcyon Castle at sunset.

days.title: Vizhinjam Harbor & Poovar Estuary
days.morning: Tour Vizhinjam fishing harbour and visit the marine aquarium housing rare pearl oysters and clownfish.
days.afternoon: Take an excursion south to Poovar Island; cruise on a motorized country craft through lush floating mangrove canals.
days.evening: Stand on Poovar’s golden sandspit where the Neyyar River meets the sea; watch sunset over the Arabian Sea.

days.title: Trivandrum Cultural Heritage
days.morning: Short drive into Thiruvananthapuram; marvel at the Dravidian gopuram of Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple.
days.afternoon: Explore Kuthira Malika (Mansion of Horses) and the Napier Museum with its Indo-Saracenic timber architecture.
days.evening: Enjoy filter coffee and hot crisp medu vada at the iconic spiral Indian Coffee House near the central station.

days.title: Catamaran Sailing & Farewell
days.morning: Experience thrilling traditional catamaran sailing with local Kovalam boatmen across coastal swells.
days.afternoon: Shop for hand-woven Balrampuram sarees, rosewood elephant carvings, and aromatic spice packets.
days.evening: Sunset cocktail overlooking the ocean before an effortless 20-minute transfer back to Trivandrum Airport.

name: Athirappilly
blurb: The dramatic "Niagara of South India", cascading 80 feet through lush Sholayar rainforest.

reach.airport: Cochin International Airport (COK, ~40 km / 1 hr 15 min - closest hill retreat from airport)
reach.railway: Chalakudy Railway Station (CKI, ~31 km) or Angamaly (AFK, ~35 km)
reach.local: Private hired taxis from Chalakudy or Kochi, KSRTC buses running to Malakkappara

tips: Monsoon Flow: Peak thundering flow is June to October; winter months (Nov–Jan) offer clear spray and gentle trekking.
Plastic-Free: Strict zero-plastic zone enforced at the forest gate; reusable bottles tagged with refundable deposit.
Base Trek: Pathway down to waterfall base is open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; wear slip-resistant shoes for wet mossy stone steps.
Swimming Warning: Swimming near the bottom of the roaring cascade is strictly banned due to fatal undertows.

days.title: First Glimpse of the Giant Cascade
days.morning: Fly into Cochin Airport (only 40 km away); drive through rubber plantations and Chalakudy river valleys.
days.afternoon: Enter the forest eco-park; walk along the stone path to the upper ledge of the 80-foot Athirappilly Falls.
days.evening: Listen to the thunderous roar echoing through Sholayar rainforest; watch hornbills return to evening roosts.

days.title: Base Trek & Vazhachal Rapids
days.morning: Hike down the designated forest trail to the very base of the waterfall to feel the cool billowing mist spray.
days.afternoon: Drive 5 km upstream to Vazhachal Falls, admiring foaming river rapids and rare medicinal plant gardens.
days.evening: Visit nearby Charpa Falls cascading right alongside the road, sampling hot forest tea and banana chips.

days.title: Thumboormuzhy Butterfly Park
days.morning: Visit Thumboormuzhy Dam; walk across the 140-meter pedestrian suspension bridge over the Chalakudy River.
days.afternoon: Walk through the landscaped butterfly garden, observing over 140 species of colourful tropical butterflies.
days.evening: Savor a homely meal of Kerala red rice, fish curry, avial, and spicy mango pickle at a riverside restaurant.

days.title: Sholayar Rainforest & Hornbills
days.morning: Guided jungle drive into the rainforests of Malakkappara; keep binoculars ready for Great Indian Hornbills.
days.afternoon: Spot Nilgiri langurs, sambar deer, and elephant herds grazing along the tea estates of the higher ranges.
days.evening: Relax by the river pool with local tribal guides sharing folklore about Western Ghats wilderness.

days.title: Ezhattumugham Nature Village
days.morning: Visit Ezhattumugham Prakriti Gramam, stepping on stone boulders across the scenic check dam.
days.afternoon: Take a final peaceful dip in shallow river streams under dense forest canopy shade.
days.evening: Quick 45-minute drive back to Cochin International Airport for your evening departure.

name: Kumarakom
blurb: Tranquil Vembanad lake waters, migratory bird sanctuary, and luxury heritage waterfront resorts.

reach.local: Traditional wooden canoes (vallam), motorized water taxis, auto-rickshaws, village bicycles

tips: Bird Sanctuary: Best birdwatching hours at Kumarakom Sanctuary are 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM; Nov–Feb brings Siberian migrants.
Pathiramanal: Reach Pathiramanal Island by motorboat or country craft; lovely 1-hour nature walk amidst rare orchids.
Canoes vs Houseboats: For intimate encounters with narrow canals and coir makers, hire a rowed wooden canoe.
Mosquito Protection: Carry herbal mosquito repellent for relaxing on lakeside open-air verandas at dusk.

days.title: Lake Vembanad & Sunset Cruise
days.morning: Arrive via Kottayam or Cochin; check into a luxury lakeside resort with heritage villas and private plunge pools.
days.afternoon: Relax on the veranda watching fishermen cast small nets and country craft drift across Lake Vembanad.
days.evening: Embark on a sunset motorboat cruise into the center of the lake; sip fresh tender coconut water as egrets fly past.

days.title: Bird Sanctuary & Village Life
days.morning: Dawn walk (6:00 AM) through Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary to spot herons, darters, teal, and kingfishers.
days.afternoon: Take a poled wooden country canoe (vallam) through quiet village canals to watch coir spinning and duck farming.
days.evening: Savour a classic Syrian Christian dinner: Duck Roast, appams, spicy beef fry, and tender coconut soufflé.

days.title: Pathiramanal Island Nature Expedition
days.morning: Motorboat trip across Vembanad to Pathiramanal Island; take a guided walking tour through its untouched jungle trails.
days.afternoon: Visit the Bay Island Driftwood Museum to inspect astonishing root and wood sculptures recovered from sea currents.
days.evening: Watch a traditional flute and tabla performance by the poolside lawn under swaying coconut palms.

days.title: Paddy Fields of Kuttanad
days.morning: Rent a cruiser bicycle to pedal along narrow bunds between the vast emerald paddy fields of Kuttanad.
days.afternoon: Meet local farmers and learn how farming is sustained below sea level with age-old biosystem canals.
days.evening: Try a rejuvenating Ayurvedic herbal oil massage to relax your muscles.

days.title: Aymanam Village Heritage & Departure
days.morning: Visit picturesque Aymanam village (setting of Arundhati Roy’s The God of Small Things); walk through ancient tharavadu homes.
days.afternoon: Enjoy a farewell lunch of Karimeen wrapped in banana leaf alongside traditional mango pachadi.
days.evening: Transfer to Kottayam railway station (30 min) or Cochin International Airport (2 hrs) for your journey home.
